title: HQ16X End-to-End Expedition Map Loop Replay Proof
head: 0bde991

notes: Covers map objective/command surface, Scout movement target preview, Scout Sector command, Event Packet marker/result, Surveyor Prepare Convoy target ring, and Settler Found Outpost target ring through existing guarded handlers.
HQ16L proves reviewed packet-derived Site Plan -> Surveyor -> Prepare Convoy bridge.
HQ16M proves Prepare Convoy -> selected Settler Convoy -> arrival-gated Found Outpost -> selected Outpost Crew.
HQ16U proves founded outpost -> next frontier beacon -> live Scout Sector route.
Confirms Scout Sector, packet-derived Site Plan drafting, Site Plan review bridge, and packet-plan result schemas in the current engine/http/tool contract layer.

loopCoverage.evidence: FP-E2E-022 and HQ16L/M data-mode, command bars, command target rings, and preview confirmations
FP-E2E-022 plus FP-UT/HT/CT Scout Sector checks; HQ16U live route also reveals a next frontier target
HQ16I proof plus FP-UT-028b and FP-HT-011d3b
HQ16K/HQ16L proof and focused browser replay
HQ16M focused browser replay blocks Found before arrival and allows it after arrival

minimalFix.reason: Focused replay was blocked by an obsolete visible-text assertion expecting CNV after the current symbol-first UI removed that literal label.
minimalFix.change: Removed the stale CNV text assertion while preserving data-mode, target-cell, Convoy, bridge, endpoint, and renderer authority checks.

gameplayGaps.gap: The loop passes as a chain of guarded bridge states, but the player still feels discrete proof slices instead of one continuous expedition run.
gameplayGaps.impact: The system works, but it does not yet feel like a single uninterrupted game loop.

gameplayGaps.gap: Packet-derived Site Plan and review are real server actions, but they are not yet strongly map-native verbs in the same way Scout, Convoy, and Found are.
gameplayGaps.impact: The middle of the loop can still read as planning paperwork unless the optional drawers stay closed and the map command path is emphasized.

gameplayGaps.gap: Prepare Convoy arrival is proven with deterministic fixture state, not a player-visible time/progress play moment.
gameplayGaps.impact: The player gets correctness, but little anticipation or game feel during the convoy transition.

gameplayGaps.gap: The outpost-to-next-Scout bridge is visible and live-route proven, but it still uses the collapsed sector alias to execute Scout Sector in HQ16U.
gameplayGaps.impact: The next frontier continuation works, but the most game-native outpost Scout command should be promoted to a direct map/command-ring path in a future bounded lane.

recommendedLanes: HQ16Y: one continuous browser replay harness for Scout -> Plan -> Review -> Convoy -> Found -> Next Scout using current guarded endpoints where possible, with fixture time control only for convoy arrival.
HQ16Z: promote packet Plan/Review and outpost Scout continuation into map-native command-ring verbs while preserving existing endpoints and optional Ledger proof.
HQ17A: add player-facing convoy progress/arrival feedback without adding scheduler, economy expansion, route behavior, rewards, or hidden autonomy.
